subject: Sandbox seat lift and promo portability request
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@novahub.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox seat lift & promo portability?

Hi Lauren / Ben,

Quick note from NovaHub — we’re wrapping up our accelerator cohort and have ~1.2M free sandbox credits remaining on the program account. The incubator asked whether those credits can be converted or applied toward a seat-based starter pack as we transition a few teams to production trials.

Two concrete asks:
- Can Redwood convert accelerator credits into an equivalent discount against a 20-seat paid pack (we’d prefer the credits to ‘port’ rather than expire)?
- If conversion is possible, can any remaining promo credits be banked onto our billing profile for future Dedicated usage (we’re looking at a pilot in us-west)?

We have a PO-ready procurement contact (procurement@novahub.ai) and an internal timeline to start the paid seats on 3/15 if we can resolve terms this week.

Appreciate a quick outline of options and any gotchas (tax/invoicing, expiration windows, legal signoffs).

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Partnerships, NovaHub Labs
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novahub.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox seat lift & promo portability?

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear asks. Short answer: yes, with conditions.

Options we can offer (high level):
1) One-time credit conversion: We can convert up to 75% of remaining accelerator credits into a one-time invoice credit that offsets the first 2 invoices for a new seat pack. This works best if the account is moved to a billing profile (company-owned) rather than a cohort sub-account.
2) Promo portability hold: For Dedicated pilot customers, we can apply a promo hold on the billing profile for up to 90 days (non-refundable) so credits are consumed before standard billing. Banking beyond 90 days requires enterprise approval.

Prereqs and notes:
- We need total monthly token/embedding forecast and expected start date to size the seat pack and confirm unit economics.
- Non-standard accounting (credit carryovers >90 days) requires legal & finance signoff — Ben will comment on commercial levers.
- If you want to convert credits into an upfront discount on a 20-seat pack, we’ll need a signed conversion template and a PO. I’ve attached the conversion_template.xlsx (blank) — fill the field on expected usage and we’ll run the math.

If you can send expected monthly token volume and confirm who will be the bill-to, I’ll loop in Marissa from Finance to expedite procurement flow.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Startup Programs — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novahub.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox seat lift & promo portability?

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Samir —

Following on Lauren’s note: we can be flexible on conversion but want clarity on the ask so accounting doesn’t treat this as revenue reclassification. Proposed commercial terms (provisional):
- 20-seat Starter Pack (annual prepay) at list $1,800 / seat / month.
- Apply up to 60% of the accelerator credits as a one-time invoice credit against the first two billing cycles (equivalent grossed discount ~30% across year 1).
- If you want credits to convert to a permanent rate discount on the base price, that requires a minimum 12‑month commit and legal approval.

If timing is tight for your 3/15 go-live, we can do a short-term bridging agreement: provisional ratecard attached (provisional-ratecard-v2.pdf) — sign that and we’ll provision seats immediately while the PO and conversion doc are finalized.

Two quick asks for our side:
- Confirm the bill-to entity (company legal name and billing address) for invoicing/tax.
- Confirm expected monthly token consumption across the 20 seats (so we can size concurrency and KV caching config).

Ping me if you want to do a 20-minute call to finalize numbers today.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Commercial Lead, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

- Signed PO (payment terms net-30) or DocuSign SOW for annual prepay
- Billing/legal contact: full legal name, remittance address, and tax ID (if US entity)

I’ve attached a brief procurement_checklist.pdf with field-level guidance. Once we receive the signed PO and completed template we’ll generate a DocuSign for a bridging agreement and queue finance to apply the one-time invoice credit.

Note on timeline: to meet 3/15 start we require completed docs by 3/10 EOD PST so prov provisioning can finish.
